bullets.text: Public in Ambattur urged authorities to repair roads and manage traffic after a girl died in a lorry accident.
A sanitation worker died inside an underground sewage tank at an Avadi sewage plant, requiring strict safety monitoring.
The meteorological center warned of heavy rain in Chennai due to the Akvan cyclone, requiring disaster readiness.
Residents of Pallikaranai passed a resolution demanding the removal of construction bans in wetland areas.
Cyber crime police conducted inspections at an apartment complex in Thiruvanmiyur East Kamaraj Nagar.
Devotees gathered in large numbers at the Besant Nagar Murugan temple in Chennai for the Kanda Sashti Soorasamharam.
Public questioned why the Tamil Nadu government has not removed 153 illegal buildings in Puzhal union despite court orders.
Authorities recovered 1,580 counterfeit books from libraries across Tiruvallur and Tiruvarur districts following inspections.
Residents in Tiruttani urged authorities to control the growing population of stray dogs roaming in the municipality.
Five library department officials were suspended following complaints regarding the procurement of fake and AI books.
MeitY questioned home services platforms regarding the collection of video and sensor data from gig workers for AI training.
High-tech cameras equipped with AI technology were installed to monitor traffic violations at 25 spots on the Krishnagiri-Hosur highway.
TVK MLA Thanga Pandian filed a police complaint stating that a woman arrested in a jewellery theft case is not a party functionary.
AirTrunk submitted plans to develop two hyperscale data center campuses backed by Blackstone in Andhra Pradesh.
The Andhra Pradesh government pushed for the development of 25 sector-specific industrial parks spanning over 25,000 acres.
